# Third-party dependencies

## CLI11

CLI11 v2.7.2 supplies command-line parsing for RE-SpyHunter, SHViewer, FrontendCapture, and the frontend/intro smoke executables. The pinned single header and its MIT license are in `CLI11/`. The header SHA-256 is `FFA9A30DA295C5858FB5F91F9F45771BAB09471D7010A34C7C68C857A330DD76`; the license SHA-256 is `CFC76368AEF8F51868FA1CDA6BCFA26E583406A4CF8E48E725E7624DF24D8855`.

The source is the [official CLI11 v2.7.2 release](https://github.com/CLIUtils/CLI11/releases/tag/v2.7.2). It is header-only, so project builds have no package restore or runtime dependency.
